messages.subject: OR | Mobility, energy transition and strategic stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear OR Executive Leadership Team,

OR's position across mobility, energy and consumer platforms creates an unusual opportunity to connect growth, sustainability and public-private partnerships. That is where my experience has become strongest.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My role covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes governance and external engagement around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, plus carbon-data readiness using physical operating evidence. I also coordinate complex public-sector interfaces and strategic stakeholder commitments across a major industrial operation.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or ASEAN roles spanning Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country strategy. I have attached an OR-focused executive CV and would appreciate your routing it to the relevant executive or talent team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
